why.heading: Why Shraddha Matters
why.intro: Shraddha is the tradition of remembering departed loved ones and ancestors with respect. It is an occasion for remembrance and gratitude, not for fear or grief.
why.whatBody: The word Shraddha is connected to श्रद्धा, reverence. Families offer water, food and service in memory of those who have passed. In many families this includes Tarpan, Pind Daan, Brahmin Bhojan and giving to others.
why.pakshaBody: Pitra Paksha is the waning-moon fortnight that follows Bhadrapada Purnima and ends on Sarva Pitru Amavasya. Purnimanta calendars place it in the month of Ashwin; Amanta calendars place it in Bhadrapada. It usually falls in September–October.
why.valuesTitle: Four feelings at the heart of it

values.label: Reverence
values.meaning: The respect in one’s heart with which the rite is performed.

values.label: Remembrance
values.meaning: Recalling the lives, the affection and the lessons of our loved ones.

values.label: Gratitude
values.meaning: Thankfulness for the values, family and life our ancestors gave us.

values.label: Service
values.meaning: Offering food, charity or help to someone in need, in their memory.

why.bhojanBody: Traditionally, a sattvic meal is cooked at home on the day of Shraddha, and a Brahmin is fed with respect and offered dakshina. Many families also set aside a portion of food for cows, crows, dogs and ants.
why.todayBody: It connects generations. Families sit together and remember grandparents and parents, and children learn the names and stories of those who came before them.
why.note: Shraddha rituals and dates differ between families, regions and traditions. Please seek guidance from your family priest or a qualified Acharya.

tradition.heading: परंपरा वही, तरीका नया।
tradition.headingNote: The tradition stays the same. The way we keep it has changed.
tradition.earlierBody: On the day of Shraddha, families invited a Brahmin home, cooked with love, and offered the meal in memory of their departed loved ones.
todayItems: Family members often live far from home, in different cities.
Busy schedules leave little time to prepare.
Many people do not know their loved one’s correct Shraddha Tithi.
It is unclear whom to contact for Brahmin Sewa.
Yet everyone wants the Sewa done with respect and in the right way.
tradition.closing: Pitra Sewa helps make this whole process simpler.
